scope.currency: virtual Şirket Bütçesi; not real money

methodology.metadata: Pillow decoded all files; SHA-256 file and decoded RGBA hashes checked for exact duplication; alpha masks measured.
methodology.visualReview: Every avatar inspected at native 32px, 96px nearest-neighbor and 64px checkerboard. Every frame inspected at 140px nearest-neighbor plus 96px/48px neutral-face composites on #111229.
methodology.selectedFramePairing: All 22 proposed frames also inspected with Icon3, Icon12 and Icon30 at 72px and 48px using an approximation of current Store geometry and bilinear sampling.
methodology.pairingLimit: 66 avatar/frame combinations at two sizes; not all 16 x 22 combinations, not a live Expo/native renderer test.
methodology.dominantColorMethod: Opaque foreground pixels (alpha >=128), RGB buckets of 32 levels per channel; top five buckets reported by mean hex and percentage of opaque foreground. These percentages need not sum to 100.
methodology.accentColorMethod: Supplemental mean colors from up to four most common hue buckets among foreground pixels with saturation >=0.45 and value >=0.35.
methodology.centralOpacityMethod: Percentage of pixels with alpha >=128 within x=30..70%, y=30..70% of a frame source; a screening proxy, not a measured face mask or a universal rejection threshold.

qualityScale.5: strong small-size silhouette and composition within this family

recommendationMeaning.KEEP: retain as a candidate; not necessarily first release
recommendationMeaning.MAYBE: reserve or review fit/variety before any listing
recommendationMeaning.REJECT: do not list in this selection; original file remains untouched

releaseConditions: Confirm source and commercial-use/distribution permission for every selected asset; appearance and filenames do not establish rights.
Approve pixel-art enlargement and cropping in the existing avatar preview at actual store/profile/compact sizes; no rendering change was made by this audit.
Check all chosen avatar/frame combinations, including tall hair, ears and headwear, on supported devices and themes before catalog integration.
Treat prices and rarity as proposals only; rejected-item prices are hypothetical if the asset is later repaired or the decision is revisited.
provenanceReview: No license/source sidecar was present in the two raw folders. Avatar PNG XMP contains editing-tool history but no inspected rights/usage-terms fields; frame PNGs expose sRGB metadata. No specific famous-character likeness or readable brand was flagged in visual review. This is not provenance verification or a rights clearance.

economyRecommendation.policy: 6 standard / 5 advanced / 4 prestige / 1 legendary avatars; 6 standard / 9 advanced / 5 prestige / 2 legendary frames. No scarcity, bundle discount, gameplay bonus or economy change is proposed.
economyRecommendation.existingCatalogContext: Current paid avatars remain 2500/4000 and frames 2000/3500, with free defaults unchanged. New proposals widen affordable choice rather than increasing existing prices.
economyRecommendation.balanceLimit: Price consistency is based on the supplied bands and current catalog, not measured player earning-rate or retention telemetry.

firstReleaseSelection.selectionReason: Strong hair silhouette and warm face stay legible on navy; lead the crimson family with this one.
Excellent expression and cyan silhouette; strong small-size representative of the cool-haired family.
Readable beard and profile offer age and silhouette variety without needing a busy accessory.
Pink hair remains distinct at 32px; simple facial structure makes this a strong accessible entry-price option.
Unusual head silhouette and high-contrast eyes add a distinct dark-series portrait.
Bright spiky silhouette separates well from navy and avoids another round fringe silhouette.
Blue shoulder edges and warm face provide enough contrast despite dark hair; a strong dark-roster anchor.
Unique botanical headwear is recognizable even when petals merge; an expressive fantasy special-series choice.
Hat, eyewear and cool hair form a readable technician identity; distinct from the bareheaded orange-haired glasses option.
Clear compact face and tall bun silhouette introduce a cool neutral into the launch palette.
Bareheaded, angular silhouette contrasts with Icon21's round beret; cap this eyewear family at two launch items.
Long vertical hair silhouette and warm/cool separation broaden the dark roster; eyes remain identifiable at small size.
Most distinctive technical/fantasy crossover silhouette; the sole suggested legendary avatar, not a resolution premium.
Symmetrical twin buns are highly recognizable and differ from the many single swept-hair portraits.
Tidy braid silhouette and centered face provide a distinct warm option without repeating long orange hair.
Expressive elder silhouette and cool accent distinguish it from Icon8's short red-bearded side profile.
Distinct square silhouette, restrained gem placement and fully clear center; strong first-release geometric option.
Clear corners and open center; a light botanical shape that differs from the many circular metal rings.
Simple bright outline, fully clear center and low visual competition; strong affordable baseline.
Distinct premium mechanism silhouette; decorative mass stays mostly at the edge and avoids the central eyes.
Bright readable silhouette and good central clearance; select one representative from the 09/29/88 family.
High separation on navy and a mostly open center; delivers energy color without a large face-blocking crest.
Bold clean construction and open center; approachable metal option distinct from delicate gold rings.
Adds a playful pastel prestige shape; the fully open face area matters more than strict cyberpunk styling.
Clear square opening and crisp simple border; an affordable angular alternative to circular rings.
Useful earthy square silhouette with less border mass than 86; preferred member of that close family.
Asymmetric organic silhouette and clear face center; avoid releasing similar green coils 58 and 80 alongside it.
Clear center, bright edge and low ornament density; stronger asymmetrical identity than the close 91 variant.
Clear gem-and-panel silhouette and adequate central opening; adds a vertical shape without a huge central crest.
Quiet, readable cool-neutral ring with a completely open center; strong low-cost alternative to gold.
Clear bright contour, open eyes and distinct cool dragon silhouette; preferable to the denser mirrored 78.
Pastel asymmetry adds variety and remains readable; side ornament stays away from the central eye pair.
Clean cool-metal contour and fully open center; keeps the metal category from being entirely copper and gold.
One of the strongest cool-metal noncircular shapes; clean opening and better clarity than the multi-stone 79.
Square floral variety with better opening and petal separation than 17/19/32; suitable first botanical companion to 04.
Distinct bead/orbit silhouette and bright accents, with less clutter than 53/62; good non-leaf arcane choice.
Distinct tapered ceremonial silhouette and earthy palette; complements the blue-gem round laurel without repeating it.
Strong two-part fire/metal silhouette, fully clear center and minimal face competition; best launch fire-rim choice.
